book.title: A Wizard of Earthsea
book.author: Ursula K. Le Guin
book.summary: A gifted, proud boy goes to a school for wizards, and in a moment of pride sets loose a shadow he must spend years hunting across the islands of Earthsea.

book.title: رجال في الشمس
book.author: غسان كنفاني
book.summary: Three men from three generations try to cross the desert to Kuwait hidden in an empty water tank. A spare, powerful story of hope and silence.

book.title: The Very Hungry Caterpillar
book.author: Eric Carle
book.summary: A caterpillar eats his way through a week of food, from one apple on Monday to a feast on Saturday, before he wraps himself up and wakes as a butterfly. A picture book to read aloud and count along with.
